DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency).

The clinical picture of a prolonged PTT with normal PT and platelets, combined with your history of excessive bleeding after tooth extraction and easy bruising, strongly indicates a defect in the intrinsic coagulation pathway. Given the severity of bleeding and lack of response to standard hemostatic measures, this is most consistent with Hemophilia A.
